comment: The CH/FL enforcement treaty (SR 0.276.195.141) is a ratified treaty with an SR number; the court defines the short name 'Vollstreckungsabkommen CH/FL'. Labelled STATUTE with the short name inside (not CONTRACT_ARTICLE, not BARE_ARTICLE); unsettled because the short name is not a classic abbreviation. Liechtenstein acts given as titles (LR 173.30) stay BARE_ARTICLE. Liechtenstein file numbers (03 CG.2016.248, ON 5) left.
